name: com.canarias/rentacar
title: Canarias.com Rentacar
description: Car hire in Tenerife with offices across the island. Real-time prices and availability.

tools.name: buscar_oficinas
tools.description: Lists Canarias.com rental offices in Tenerife for pickup and drop-off.

tools.name: buscar_disponibilidad
tools.description: Searches available cars and final prices for given dates and Tenerife offices. Returns only Canarias.com's own fleet. The enlaceBusquedaWeb field contains the complete website price list. The modoEnlace field identifies the configured continuation mode. The price includes full insurance with no excess (drivers aged 23 or over, subject to terms). Each offer also shows the deposit. Each result includes precioOnline (advance online payment, 10% online payment discount; null when only pay at pickup is available), precioEnOficina (standard rate, paid at pickup), ahorroOnline (precioEnOficina minus precioOnline, computed by the engine) and, when available, resumenPrecio (ready-made text with both prices). Online payment is optional; prepaid rentals can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before pickup, with a refund. The deposit guarantees the car is returned on time.

recogida.description: Local pickup date and time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm

devolucion.description: Local drop-off date and time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm

tools.name: ver_oferta
tools.description: Returns the details of an offer from Canarias.com's own fleet: car, priced extras, terms, full insurance with no excess included (drivers aged 23 or over, subject to terms) and deposit. Each result includes precioOnline (advance online payment, 10% online payment discount; null when only pay at pickup is available), precioEnOficina (standard rate, paid at pickup), ahorroOnline (precioEnOficina minus precioOnline, computed by the engine) and, when available, resumenPrecio (ready-made text with both prices). Online payment is optional; prepaid rentals can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before pickup, with a refund. The deposit guarantees the car is returned on time.

tools.name: crear_enlace_reserva
tools.description: For clients explicitly using the legacy draft flow, prepares the selected car and extras and returns a single-use link to the pre-filled booking form on rentacar.canarias.com. Customer details are optional and included only with permission. The customer reviews current availability and the final price and completes the booking on the website. The link expires after at most 30 minutes, or sooner if the offer expires. The response contains enlace (the continuation URL), caducaEnMinutosMaximos (maximum validity in minutes), mensajeCliente (customer-facing text) and aviso (the reminder that completion takes place on the website). This tool does not book, charge or cancel.

extras.description: Selected extras by ID and quantity

pagoOnline.description: Initial payment preference; the customer can change it on the website

cliente.description: Optional customer details shared with permission
